rows.text: Sin only exiles and copies permanent cards from your graveyard; instants and sorceries are completely ignored, keeping your hits concentrated on real board presence. More importantly, when Sin hits a land card, it creates a tapped copy and repeats the process immediately. A graveyard stocked with multiple fetchlands and duals allows Sin to chain through all of them in a single enter or attack trigger, ramping multiple lands onto the battlefield before capping off with a game-ending titan.

Bracket 3: the Game Changer cap is three, filled by Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, and Rhystic Study. No mass land denial. This deck intentionally avoids infinite combos, winning through overwhelming value, oppressive permanent triggers, and Craterhoof overrun finishes.

guide.title: The engine: Sin and chained copies

rows.name: Sin, Spira's Punishment
rows.text: a 7/7 flying Leviathan that triggers on both entry and attack. It exiles a permanent card from your graveyard at random and creates a tapped token copy of it, repeating the trigger whenever it hits a land.

rows.name: Amulet of Vigor
rows.text: whenever a permanent enters the battlefield tapped, untap it. The lands and creatures Sin creates enter tapped; Amulet untaps them immediately, letting chained lands tap for mana right away and giving token creatures pseudo-vigilance.

rows.name: Spelunking
rows.text: draws a card and allows lands you control to enter the battlefield untapped, ensuring that every land Sin chains from the graveyard is immediately active.

rows.name: Shifting Woodland
rows.text: delirium allows this land to become a copy of any permanent card in your graveyard for {2}{G}{G}, letting you duplicate an Archon, Toxrill, or Portal to Phyrexia without needing Sin on the board.

rows.name: Talon Gates of Madara
rows.text: a utility land that phases out a creature upon entering. When Sin copies this from the graveyard, you can phase out an opposing threat or blocker, or phase out Sin to protect it from targeted removal.

rows.name: Six
rows.text: gives all nonland permanent cards in your graveyard retrace, while attacking to mill three cards and return a land to your hand.

rows.name: Archon of Cruelty
rows.text: a premier hit for Sin. On entry and attack, an opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker, discards a card, and loses 3 life, while you draw a card and gain 3 life.

rows.name: Toxrill, the Corrosive
rows.text: places slime counters on all opposing creatures at each end step, shrinking the table's boards while creating an army of Slugs and drawing cards.

rows.name: Portal to Phyrexia
rows.text: nine-mana artifact that forces each opponent to sacrifice three creatures when it enters and reanimates a creature from any graveyard on upkeep.

rows.name: Vaultborn Tyrant
rows.text: draws a card and gains 3 life whenever a creature with power 4 or greater enters, triggering off itself, Sin, and any other massive token copy.

rows.name: Hullbreaker Horror
rows.text: uncounterable 7/8 flash threat that turns every instant and sorcery into an uncounterable bounce for opposing spells or nonland permanents.

rows.name: Koma, Cosmos Serpent
rows.text: uncounterable powerhouse that generates 3/3 Serpents every upkeep to tap down opposing permanents and grant itself indestructible.

rows.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: gives your entire board trample and massive power boosts based on creature count to close the game on an alpha strike.

rows.name: The Great Henge
rows.text: provides two green mana, life gain, +1/+1 counters, and draw on creature entry, cast cheaply off Sin's 7 power.

rows.name: Avenger of Zendikar
rows.text: creates a Plant token for each land you control, then pumps them whenever Sin chains lands into play.

rows.name: Rampaging Baloths

A strong opening hand contains two to three lands, early mana acceleration (Sol Ring, Birds of Paradise, Delighted Halfling, Farseek, Nature's Lore), and a self-mill or discard outlet (Grisly Salvage, Hermit Druid, Entomb, Frantic Search, Mesmeric Orb).
Turn 1-2: Develop mana and fix colors. Cast dorks or early mill pieces like Stitcher's Supplier or Hermit Druid.
Turn 3-4: Stock the graveyard with high-impact permanents using Buried Alive, Grisly Salvage, or Frantic Search. Deploy value engines like Rhystic Study or Spelunking.
Turn 5-6: Deploy haste enablers or flicker pieces (Lightning Greaves, Thassa, Deep-Dwelling, Yarok). Cast Sin, Spira's Punishment.

Turn 7+: Trigger Sin's enter ability to chain lands and resurrect an Archon, Toxrill, or Vaultborn Tyrant. Declare attacks with Sin to trigger the ability a second time. Overwhelm the table with massive permanent triggers, controlling the stack with Mana Drain and Cyclonic Rift, then finish with Craterhoof Behemoth.
